extraction.Name: Emily Colomb (Miller)
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I did not think there was any use as I was under the impression that I had to take it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Buyer: The deed to Emma Colomb was for $5600 but I really got $6500 as it was sold to another party.
extraction.Occupation/Income: By my husband. I keep house of course.
extraction.NOTES: Delivered at the Security Bank in Winner in 1918; does not remember signing a receipt; has three children; received $6500.00 in cash and settled no debts with the purchaser; satisfied with the sale; document subscribed and sworn before notary May 1st, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32.
